question: In right △ABC, ∠B=90°, AC=2√5 cm and AB−BC=2 cm. Find cos²A−cos²C.
independent_reasoning: Let the legs be x=AB and y=BC. x²+y²=20 and (x−y)²=4, so 2xy=16 and (x+y)²=36; since x>y, x=4 and y=2. Thus cos²A−cos²C=(x²−y²)/AC²=(16−4)/20=3/5.
